newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen expects balanced budget in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Yemen expects balanced budget in 1998.

text.p: Yemen said on Sunday it expected a balanced budget by 1998 thanks to the economic reforms it was implementing.
"We expect the budget deficit to be gone in 1998 because of successes resulting from the economic reforms programme," Prime Minister Abdul-Aziz Abdul-Ghani said in a news conference.
"Our estimates for the budget deficit in 1996 were 25 billion rials ($250 million) but the final results showed a deficit of less than two billion rials."
The government last month approved the 1997 national budget with spending estimated at 313 billion rials while revenues were forcast at 301 billion rials.
It carried a lower forcast deficit of 12 billion rials from the 25.53 billion projected for 1996.
